known_issues: Uploaded video does not appear on the feed after upload

existing_features.title: After a successful video upload via the Upload page, the newly created video must appear in the main feed (Feed.tsx) without requiring a manual page refresh. Ensure the feed query cache is invalidated or refetched after the createVideo mutation completes successfully.

new_feature_requests.summary: Verify that the backend `createVideo` function correctly persists the uploaded video to stable storage and returns it in the `getVideos` (or equivalent feed-fetch) query. If the video is not being stored or returned by the backend feed query, fix the persistence or retrieval logic in backend/main.mo.
